changelog: DeskAI v2.5.1 (Build 40): sign-ins for computer tasks. When a site asks for a password or code, you can pick 'Type my password' or the site's own options like 'Try another way'. A password or code is typed on DeskAI's own screen, in a hidden field with screenshots blocked; it goes straight into the box on the Mini and the AI never sees it. Alerts for cancelled or answered requests now clear from your phone.
